create.title: Create a professional menu with Artificial Intelligence.
create.subtitle: Describe your business in as much detail as possible and KYVERON automatically builds a modern, fully editable menu for you.
create.placeholder:
Example:

I have an Italian restaurant called Bella Napoli located in Lisbon.
I want an elegant menu in black and gold.
We sell artisan pizzas, pasta, Italian desserts and drinks.
The style should feel sophisticated.
create.hint: The more detail, the better the menu the AI creates.
create.tooShort: Please write at least {{min}} characters so the AI can build a quality menu.
create.examplesSubtitle: Click an example to auto-fill the editor.

burger.label: Burger Joint
burger.prompt: I run an artisan burger joint called Smoke House in Porto. We serve gourmet burgers, rustic fries, craft beers and milkshakes. I want a modern, urban menu with dark tones and orange accents.

pizzeria.label: Pizzeria
pizzeria.prompt: I run an Italian pizzeria called Bella Napoli in Lisbon. We serve artisan pizzas, pasta, Italian desserts and drinks. I want an elegant menu in black and gold with a sophisticated style.

restaurant.label: Restaurant
restaurant.prompt: I run a Mediterranean restaurant in Cascais with contemporary Portuguese cuisine. We serve starters, fish dishes, meat dishes, desserts and a wine selection. I want an elegant, minimalist menu.

pastry.label: Pastry Shop
pastry.prompt: I run an artisan pastry shop in Braga specialising in cakes, traditional Portuguese sweets and specialty coffee. I want a delicate menu with classic typography and soft pastel and gold tones.

bakery.label: Bakery
bakery.prompt: I run a neighbourhood bakery in Coimbra with fresh bread, sandwiches, croissants, fresh juices and coffee. I want a warm, artisan menu that is easy to read.

cafe.label: Café
cafe.prompt: I run a specialty coffee shop in downtown Porto with filter methods, espresso, vegan pastries and brunch. I want a clean, modern and minimalist menu.

sushi.label: Sushi
sushi.prompt: I run a sushi restaurant in Lisbon with combos, uramaki, temaki, gunkan, sashimi and hot dishes. I want a contemporary, dark menu with red accents.

acai.label: Açaí Shop
acai.prompt: I run an açaí shop in Almada with custom bowls, smoothies, healthy toppings and natural juices. I want a young, vibrant and colourful menu.

gelato.label: Gelato Shop
gelato.prompt: I run an Italian artisan gelato shop in Aveiro with gelato, sorbets, waffles, crepes and milkshakes. I want a playful menu with pastel colours and delicate illustrations.

foodtruck.label: Food Truck
foodtruck.prompt: I run a food truck at festivals with Mexican tacos, quesadillas, nachos and craft sodas. I want an informal, urban and vibrant menu.
